text: {"sql":"SELECT agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS incident_date, fault_code, COUNT(*) AS fault_event_count FROM sf_fleet.agv_telemetry WHERE fault_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE), fault_code ORDER BY fault_event_count DESC LIMIT 20","columns":["agv_id","incident_date","fault_code","fault_event_count"],"purpose":"Pinpoint when each AGV recorded telemetry faults by grouping fault events per AGV per date and fault code, ordered by frequency."}

data.sql: SELECT agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS incident_date, fault_code, COUNT(*) AS fault_event_count FROM sf_fleet.agv_telemetry WHERE fault_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agv_id, CAST(ts AS DATE), fault_code ORDER BY fault_event_count DESC LIMIT 20
data.purpose: Pinpoint when each AGV recorded telemetry faults by grouping fault events per AGV per date and fault code, ordered by frequency.
